answer.description: Provider-generated answer when requested (e.g. via Tavily include_answer or Perplexity). Preserved independently of include_raw.

expires_at.description: Expiration of result IDs for deferred retrieval. Results expire 24 hours after search completion.

id.description: Search resource ID. Request tracing uses X-Request-Id.

provider.description: Concrete serving provider, never auto or fallback.

query.description: Echo of the query. Native multi-query inputs are visible in the selected strategy target and the optional raw response.

raw.description: Full serving-provider response, including top-level metadata that does not belong to a result. Present only with include_raw=true; untrusted provider data.

type.description: Let Kernel choose an eligible provider by capability fit.

count.description: Provider-native count. Lower-only alias for max_results; cannot raise the effective result cap.

goggles_id.description: Deprecated Brave Goggle identifier. Prefer goggles.

offset.description: Page offset supported by Brave.

result_filter.description: Comma-separated result types to include, e.g. "web,news".

ui_lang.description: Language for UI strings in the response.

browser_id.description: Existing browser session ID authorized for the caller and selected project. Reuses its cookies, proxy, and browser configuration; requests follow that browser's existing network access behavior, with no additional destination allowlist in this endpoint. Kernel does not delete a caller-supplied browser. Render mode uses a temporary tab; website activity may still change shared cookies and storage. When omitted and any result needs browser retrieval, Kernel creates one temporary browser for the request using the dashboard launch defaults (headful, stealth, default proxy), tags it with search_id, and deletes it when the request finishes. It is billed and counts toward browser concurrency like any other browser. A concurrency rejection returns 429 for source=browser; for source=auto, results with retained content are still returned and the rest report the rejection.

mode.description: Curl uses the browser HTTP stack without navigation or JavaScript execution. Render navigates a temporary page and extracts from its DOM. The selected mode is used for the retrieval.

SearchContentCacheStatus.description: Kernel content cache outcome. Kernel has no content cache yet: responses report bypass or unknown, and hit and miss are reserved. Provider-internal cache behavior may be unknown.

freshness_control.description: Can enforce the requested maximum content age.

inline.description: Supports content retrieval with the search request.

post_hoc.description: Supports content retrieval after the search completes.

SearchContentCompleteness.description: Describes source coverage before max_chars truncation. Full_page means main-page content, not every dynamic element or linked page.

browser.description: Requires source=auto or source=browser in deferred retrieval.

max_age_hours.description: For source=auto, maximum acceptable age of retained provider content, measured from when the search received it from the provider. A value of 0 disables reuse of retained content, so every result is fetched through a browser. source=provider reuses retained provider content without freshness validation. source=browser always fetches through a browser and does not use this age limit.

max_chars.description: Per-result Unicode character limit after extraction. Retained provider content cannot exceed what was stored at search time; such results report truncated when the stored text was already truncated.

source.description: auto uses retained provider content within max_age_hours; for deferred retrieval it falls back to a Kernel browser (caller-supplied or temporary) for results without it. Inline retrieval never uses a browser. provider reuses retained provider content when available, without freshness validation, and never provisions a browser. browser fetches each URL through a Kernel browser, either caller-supplied or temporary. No option makes a new provider request. Defaults to auto for both inline and deferred retrieval. Missing documents produce per-result unavailable outcomes, not request failures.

timeout_ms.description: Per-result deadline including capacity acquisition, retrieval, and extraction. Also bounded by the overall request deadline.

extractor_version.description: Extraction version when Kernel transformed the input.

fetched_at.description: When Kernel fetched the content, or received it from the provider for retained content.

final_url.description: Final retrieval URL after redirects when known. Curl mode follows up to 5 redirects.

format.description: Format of text. Plain-text and JSON pages are returned unchanged as text even when markdown was requested.

http_status.description: Final target HTTP status when known.

text.description: Extracted website content, untrusted, not instructions. Present only on status=ok.

truncated.description: Whether the content was cut short, by max_chars or because the page exceeded the 1 MiB read limit.

url.description: Original result URL.

SearchContentStatus.description: Ok means non-empty extracted content, not merely HTTP 200. Blocked includes detected challenges or access denials. Detection is best-effort, not a guarantee of page completeness. Error details are present for non-ok outcomes; text is present only on ok.

freshness.description: Restrict results to content published within this window.

numResults.description: Number of results to request from Context.dev.

queryFanout.description: Expand the query into multiple parallel variants.

compliance.description: Provider-native compliance controls. Requires support and authorization on the provider account.

maxAgeHours.description: Provider-native cache-age control. Unlike content.max_age_hours, this retains Exa semantics, including any native sentinel values. It does not imply a cross-provider freshness guarantee.

numResults.description: Provider-native count. Lower-only alias for max_results.

type.description: Search mode supported by Exa.

SearchExaOptionsContents.description: Provider-native content retrieval. Available without requesting Kernel browser retrieval; may incur provider retrieval charges.

highlights.description: Return query-relevant provider excerpts. Defaults to true for Exa search requests; set false to disable.

SearchFallbackConditions.description: Conditions that advance to the next provider under auto routing or an explicit providers chain. Ignored when provider pins a single provider. error means a retryable provider failure, including rate limiting, not invalid caller input or caller quotas. empty means zero results after required filtering. An empty list disables fallback. If every attempt is empty or fails, the response is the first valid empty response with the full attempt trail, or a 502 if none succeeded.

providers.description: Ordered provider targets. Provider names must be unique.

type.description: Try providers in order and advance when fallback_on matches the outcome.

mode.description: Search mode. Basic is used when omitted; each mode can have different latency and charges.

objective.description: The goal behind the search, stated separately from the query.

search_queries.description: Provider-native multi-query search. Defaults to [query] for this provider.

session_id.description: Group related searches.

SearchParallelOptionsAdvancedSettings.description: Explicit search settings. Unified search parameters are re-applied to overlapping settings; native result counts are lower-only.

max_results.description: Native count; lower-only alias for unified max_results.

disable_cache_fallback.description: When false, the provider may return cached content after live fetching fails.

max_age_seconds.description: Native live-fetch trigger; minimum 600 seconds. Not the unified hard-freshness control.

timeout_seconds.description: Native live-fetch timeout, bounded by the remaining overall deadline.

exclude_domains.description: Native exclusions; the provider ignores these when native include_domains is non-empty.

include_domains.description: Native domain/path restrictions. Explicit unified domain parameters take precedence. Combined include/exclude native lists cannot exceed 200 entries.

last_updated_after_filter.description: MM/DD/YYYY. Filters by last-updated date, not published date.

last_updated_before_filter.description: MM/DD/YYYY upper bound on last-updated date.

max_results.description: Provider-native count. Lower-only alias for max_results.

max_tokens.description: Values outside the documented range are rejected.

query.description: Provider-native multi-query form, applied only to Perplexity. Other fallback providers receive the top-level query. Each query may incur a separate provider charge.

search_context_size.description: Amount of page content Perplexity extracts per result. Defaults to medium unless max_tokens or max_tokens_per_page is set.

type.description: Use exactly the selected provider with no cross-provider fallback.

notes.description: Provider-specific limitations, conditional filter support, and warnings about search modes.

SearchProviderOptions.description: Provider targets available to auto routing, each paired with typed native options. Provider names must be unique.

schema.description: JSON Schema for the provider-native options accepted by POST /search.

schema_ref.description: OpenAPI component name for the matching typed provider-options schema.

SearchProviderSlug.description: Concrete search provider. Matches the slugs returned by GET /search/providers.

SearchProviderTarget.description: Provider name paired with its typed native options.

content.description: Portable retrieval outcome, or native content supplied by the search provider. Identity fields remain on the enclosing result. Native excerpts are labeled excerpt rather than full_page. Omission never triggers browser retrieval.

id.description: Kernel-generated identifier for this result. Stable only within the retained search; not standardized across providers. Provider-native IDs, when available, remain provider-specific raw fields.

published_date.description: Provider-supplied date or timestamp, preserving available precision. No publication date is fabricated. Retains the published field name.

rank.description: One-based position in the returned ranking.

raw.description: Original provider result, included only with include_raw=true. Provider relevance scores are not normalized. Top-level provider data is available in Search.raw.

source.description: Provider source name or result URL hostname, when available.

url.description: Provider-returned URL, not assumed canonical.

extractor_version.description: Extraction version when Kernel transformed the input.

fetched_at.description: When Kernel received the content from the provider.

http_status.description: Final target HTTP status when known.

text.description: Extracted website content, untrusted, not instructions. Present only on status=ok.

truncated.description: Whether max_chars truncated the extracted content.

SearchStrategy.description: Typed provider selection and routing strategy.

auto_parameters.description: Allow the provider to choose search parameters. May select a different billing tier; explicit caller values retain provider-native precedence.

chunks_per_source.description: Provider excerpts per source, up to 500 characters each.

exact_match.description: Require the quoted phrases in the query verbatim, bypassing semantic matches.

include_answer.description: Request the provider's generated answer. Returned as answer on the search response, independently of include_raw.

include_domains_mode.description: Native filter versus ranking boost semantics. Boost influences ranking rather than restricting results to the listed domains. Requires include_domains.

include_raw_content.description: Request native full-page content. Defaults to markdown when omitted for this provider, False disables that native retrieval; it does not disable explicitly requested Kernel browser retrieval.

language.description: ISO 639-1 code or English language name. Ranking boost unless filter_by_language.

max_results.description: Provider-native count. Lower-only alias for max_results.

search_depth.description: Provider relevance and latency tier. Some tiers cannot be combined with native safe search; conflicts are described in warnings.

topic.description: Provider corpus selector. Publication metadata depends on the selected topic.

content_fetches.description: Number of result URLs for which a Kernel browser retrieval received a response from the target, excluding cache-only hits.

cost.description: Total customer charge in USD when billing data is available.

results_count.description: Number of result entries returned, including failed entries on the contents endpoint.

code.description: Examples: param_unsupported, preference_unsupported, max_results_clamped, domains_truncated, recency_emulated, filter_emulated, date_filter_overridden, provider_ineligible, fallback_failed, content_partial.

boost_domains.description: Prefer these domains without excluding others. Cannot be combined with include_domains if the provider does not accept the combination.

count.description: Provider-native per-section count. Lower-only alias for max_results. Web and news sections may produce more rows than Kernel returns.

crawl_timeout.description: Native extraction timeout in seconds, bounded by the remaining Kernel request deadline.

knowledge.description: Request licensed-data output. URL-less knowledge entries are not converted into web results; include_raw exposes the full provider response separately.

language.description: BCP 47 result language from You.com's 51-value enum, e.g. "EN", "JA". Default EN.

offset.description: Page offset supported by You.com.

SearchYouOptionsExtraction.description: Provider-native page extraction. Both modes may incur per-row charges; full_page may retrieve web and news rows.

last_used_at.description: When one of the account's API keys last authenticated or one of its rules last issued a token. Recorded at most once every 15 minutes, so it can lag. Null if the account has never been used.

security_version.description: Authority revision. Cosmetic updates do not widen permissions.

hidden.description: Whether the cursor should be hidden or visible

ShopPayCardState.description: Issued Shop Pay cards retain encrypted card material for the fill operation.

status.description: declined covers a request the shopper declined or that was cancelled. consumed means the transaction outcome was reported with confirm_transaction; the card is no longer stored and cannot be filled again, whatever the outcome. recovery_required means a provider operation has an unresolved outcome and the card cannot be used. When status_reason says the provider refused retrieval before acceptance, no card was issued and a later read retries. Otherwise follow status_reason: recovery for issuance can be abandoned by deleting the card and creating a new one, and the shopper approves the new purchase separately. Recovery while reporting a merchant transaction cannot be deleted and must be reconciled with support.

ShopPayCardVaultItemSpec.description: Shop Pay purchase. amount is the limit the shopper approves; totals must include exactly one positive total no higher than it. context is shown to the shopper when they approve. Authorize it with the browser at final checkout: Kernel sends that page to Shop as the merchant and the card fills only on its origin. Without browser_id and page_url it authorizes for merchant_url. authorize returns an approval action for the shopper, who approves the purchase in Shop; share its URL unchanged when present. Report the merchant outcome with confirm_transaction, which ends the card.

amount.description: Approval limit in minor currency units, at most 1000000.

context.description: What is being bought and why, written for the shopper.

currency.description: Shop accepts USD spend requests only.

merchant_country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country of the merchant.

payment_method_id.description: Card ID from the wallet's payment_methods expansion. Omit it to use the shopper's preferred card.

wallet.description: Connected Shop Pay wallet item key.

unit_amount.description: Unit price in minor currency units.

url.description: Shop sign-in page where the shopper connects their Shop account to Kernel.

amount.description: Amount in minor currency units; discounts are negative.

type.description: For example subtotal, fulfillment, tax, discount or total.

ShopPayWalletVaultItemSpec.description: Shop Pay wallet connected through Kernel's Shop app. Creation returns a shop_pay_oauth action: the shopper signs in to Shop and approves the connection, and the wallet connects. The connected wallet's payment_methods expansion lists the shopper's saved Shop Pay cards.

SignInOption.description: A non-MFA choice presented during the auth flow (e.g. account selection, org picker)

description.description: Additional context such as email address or org name

id.description: Unique identifier for this option (used to submit selection back)

SingleUseCardBillingAddress.description: Billing address filled with the billing_* fill fields. Never returned.

SleepAction.description: Pause execution for a specified duration.

accepted.description: Whether the submission was accepted for processing

Task.description: A goal an agent works toward. Reports are submitted against a task, and browsers can be linked to it. Tasks are immutable apart from added browser links.

description.description: What the task is meant to accomplish

session_ids.description: IDs of browsers linked to the task, oldest link first. Linked browsers may since have been deleted.

started_at.description: When work on the task started

target_website.description: Hostname of the website the task targets

TaskMetadata.description: Caller-defined string key-value pairs for grouping and filtering tasks, such as a user or thread ID. At most 20 keys; keys are 1-64 characters, values at most 256 characters, and keys and values together at most 4 KB.

text.description: Text to type on the browser instance

UpdateAccessTokenVaultItemOperationReque.description: Replace the stored access token on a wallet whose grant your backend refreshes, such as a Link wallet imported with token_refresh=customer. The token must come from the grant the wallet was imported with. Kernel stores it without contacting the provider and never refreshes or revokes the grant. Call it when an operation returns 409 with code access_token_rejected, then retry that operation. Existing cards and pending spend requests keep their state. Requires vault write access. For a stored-token 1Password credential, use 1pw_update_access_token instead.

name.description: Immutable name assigned when the vault is created.

VaultAgentCardProviderConfig.description: Response schema for an AgentCard configuration, without secret credentials. Kernel generates the ID and timestamps and introspects test_mode from the credentials. Configuration creation uses VaultAgentCardProviderConfigRequest.

test_mode.description: Introspected mode of the selected credential; true means sandbox objects.

VaultAgentCardProviderConfigRequest.description: Register application credentials for AgentCard wallet enrollment and checkout approvals. Kernel obtains application access tokens using client_credentials.

name.description: Unique within the organization.

VaultCheckoutContext.description: Required when preparing an unused AgentCard card for a supported checkout processor. Consent is bound to this browser and declared merchant origin, not a tab. Wait for the item's ready_to_submit status before native Pay and submit within its readiness deadline. Unused preparations expire automatically; every preparation is single-use, including after failure or expiry.

browser_id.description: Active browser session with this vault bound to it.

environment.description: Use production or sandbox for Square, Braintree, Worldpay and Adyen; shared for Bambora and Mercado Pago. Shared endpoints do not establish test mode. Merchant credentials/configuration determine processor test mode, independently of the AgentCard credential mode.

merchant_origin.description: Canonical HTTPS origin of the top-level merchant document, not a processor iframe. HTTP localhost is accepted for tests.

psp.description: Checkout processor. Omit for Square compatibility. Adyen supports fresh-card Sessions requests on Adyen hosts only. Use public dummy card fields, not vault aliases. The unique armed preparation is associated with the subsequent eligible request from this browser and declared merchant origin; competing preparations are rejected.

VaultEncryptionKey.description: Public key for encrypted_value on credential fields. Use this only if you run your own credential collection web app and want values encrypted in the browser, sent to your backend still encrypted, and forwarded to Kernel's API still encrypted. In every other case, including server-side code that already holds the plaintext, use value. Each vault has its own key; a value encrypted for one vault is rejected by every other vault. The key is created on first request and stays the same for the vault's lifetime, so it may be cached.

kid.description: Key ID. Set it as the kid protected header of every encrypted_value.

VaultEncryptionPublicJWK.description: P-256 public key in JWK form.

field.description: A credential field name from the item's declared fields (Kernel) or state.fields from a single-item read (managed auth), or a supported card field. Unset credential fields cannot be filled.

format.description: Required only for a card's combined expiration field. Forbidden for other card fields and all credential fields.

error_code.description: Present only for failed or unknown fields. Never includes secret values, DOM content, or raw browser errors.

index.description: Zero-based index into the request fields array.

status.description: Filled means the fill action completed, not that the website retained or accepted the value.

browser_id.description: Browser session associated with the event, when applicable.

VaultItemExpanded.description: Live, non-persisted data requested through the item GET expand parameter.

link_shipping_addresses.description: Link's saved shipping addresses, present when the `link_shipping_addresses` expansion is requested.

token_last4.description: Last four digits of the network token presented to the merchant.

VaultItemOperationResponse.description: Authorization and preparation return the existing item shape. Fill and passkey operations return value-free results; WebMCP invocation returns the tool's output. None persist transient outcomes on the item. Payment-method operations return the affected wallet payment method.

VaultItemUpdateRequest.description: Type must match the stored item; an update cannot change item type. Legacy card updates may omit type; payment_request updates require it. Credential updates require explicit type and version. Wallet updates are unsupported.

publishable_key.description: Stripe publishable key for the account that owns the Link OAuth client. Link requires it as the bearer credential when Kernel refreshes or revokes imported wallet grants; without it, those wallets stop working when the imported access token expires.

VaultLinkProviderConfig.description: Response schema for a Link configuration, without secret credentials. Kernel generates the ID and timestamps. Configuration creation uses VaultLinkProviderConfigRequest.

client_id.description: OAuth client identity; immutable. Secret credentials are never returned.

name.description: Unique within the organization.

publishable_key.description: Stripe publishable key sent to Link when refreshing and revoking wallet grants. Omitted when not configured.

VaultLinkProviderConfigRequest.description: Register a customer-owned Link OAuth client for refreshing and revoking imported wallet grants. The customer is responsible for initiating OAuth flows to connect a user's wallet and handling the redirect to obtain a Link access token and refresh token.

name.description: Unique within the organization.

expires_at.description: Expiry of a pending enrollment link or ingest URL.

is_default.description: For Kernel wallets, true for the default card, ID card, which a Kernel card item that omits payment_method_id selects. Wallets created with payment methods enabled have no default card.

issuer_reference.description: Kernel wallets only. The issuer's reference for a card it pushed with a card_ingest URL.

provider.description: Provider that issued this payment-method ID.

status.description: Kernel wallets only. pending_enrollment means a card_enrollment link or card_ingest URL is open; active means the card is stored and can pay when capabilities.single_use_card.eligible is true; removal_pending means removal started but the provider outcome is unknown, so retry remove_payment_method; recovery_required means either an enrollment outcome is unknown (remove the method), or the stored card cannot be read (contact support; removal is refused with 409). Consult status_reason to distinguish these cases. Absent for other providers.

type.description: Provider-neutral payment-method type normalized to lowercase.

valid_until.description: Kernel wallets only. When a card pushed with a card_ingest URL stops being usable, as its issuer set.

VaultPaymentMethodAction.description: The open enrollment of a pending payment method. card_enrollment is a single-use hosted link for the cardholder. card_ingest is a single-use URL on a Kernel ingest hostname served by the card vault, which the card's issuer posts the card to from its backend; Kernel never receives the card number or CVC.

capture_token.description: Secret bearer capability for embedded card capture with @onkernel/vault-react. Present only on card_enrollment for Kernel wallets; never for AgentCard. Treat it like the enrollment URL and do not log or persist it in browser storage.

VaultPaymentMethodCapabilities.description: Provider-reported advisory capabilities. A missing capability is unknown, not ineligible; only eligible=false is an explicit negative signal.

VaultProviderConfigReference.description: Select a provider config by ID or name. Responses return the ID. Renaming a config does not change existing wallet bindings; an item cannot switch to a different config after creation.

VaultProviderConfigRequest.description: Provider-specific settings and credentials for a configuration shared across the organization's projects.

VaultReference.description: Reference to a project-scoped vault. Provide exactly one of id or name.

VaultVgsProviderConfig.description: Response schema for a customer-managed VGS vault configuration, without the client secret. Kernel generates the ID and timestamps. Configuration creation uses VaultVgsProviderConfigRequest.

client_id.description: Service account identity; immutable. The client secret is never returned.

name.description: Unique within the organization.

vault_id.description: The customer's VGS vault ID; immutable.

VaultVgsProviderConfigRequest.description: Register a service account for a customer-managed VGS vault. Kernel fetches a token, requires the aliases:read scope, and then looks up an alias that does not exist to confirm the account reaches vault_id in environment. If either check fails, nothing is stored.

name.description: Unique within the organization.

VaultVgsProviderCredentials.description: A VGS service account with the aliases:read scope on the customer's vault, which Kernel uses to reveal the aliases each purchase sends.

field.description: A declared, populated credential field or supported card field. A TOTP field supplies a fresh code, never its seed. Passkey fields cannot be filled.

format.description: Required for card expiration (MM/YY or MM/YYYY), forbidden for other fields. Invalid formats are rejected before invocation.

input_path.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer to an existing null value in input. Object keys are exact; array indices must be canonical and in range. No root or array-append paths. Each path and each field may occur only once.

VgsCardInput.description: The card supplied to a purchase, as aliases in the customer's VGS vault. With card_mode full it is a whole card: a persistent alias of its number, a freshly collected volatile alias of its security code, its expiry and its last four digits. With card_mode cvc_only it is a CVC alias alone, because the merchant holds the rest on file. pan_alias, exp_month, exp_year and last4 are required with card_mode full and rejected with card_mode cvc_only. Write-only: stored encrypted and never returned in the item, its events or logs. A repeated PUT with the same key must send the same card.

cvc_alias.description: A volatile alias of a freshly collected security code in the customer's vault. It must still exist when authorize runs. Required in both modes.

exp_month.description: Required with card_mode full, rejected with card_mode cvc_only.

exp_year.description: Required with card_mode full, rejected with card_mode cvc_only.

last4.description: The card number's last four digits, checked against the revealed alias. Required with card_mode full, rejected with card_mode cvc_only.

pan_alias.description: A persistent alias of the card number in the customer's vault. Required with card_mode full, rejected with card_mode cvc_only.

VgsCardState.description: A ready VGS card supports fill, then submit checkout, until expires_at. Kernel does not observe whether the merchant charged the card. masks.last4 is the card's last four digits.

domains.description: Informational registrable domain. Fill is locked to merchant_url's exact origin.

status.description: requested until authorize reveals the aliases; if the reveal fails before anything is stored, authorize returns 503 provider_unavailable and the card stays requested. declined means authorize was refused: invalid_card for aliases that do not match the card or a card that has expired (fix the input and create a new card), alias_not_found when the customer's vault has no such alias, usually an expired CVC alias (collect the CVC again and create a new card), or provider_credentials_rejected when VGS refused the configuration's service account (update the provider configuration and create a new card). ready lasts until the CVC alias expires, then expired.

VgsCardVaultItemSpec.description: One live purchase with a card in the customer's VGS vault. With card_mode full, authorize reveals card.pan_alias and card.cvc_alias through Kernel's VGS outbound proxy; with card_mode cvc_only, for a card the merchant already holds on file whose checkout page asks only for the security code, it reveals card.cvc_alias alone. The proxy replaces each revealed value with an alias in Kernel's vault before it reaches Kernel; Kernel never receives the card number or security code. The card is then ready with no further approval, until expires_at, by default five minutes after authorize. fill types Kernel's aliases on merchant_url's origin, and Kernel's VGS proxy replaces them with the card's details when the browser submits checkout; a cvc_only card fills only the cvc field, and reports no masks because it has no last4 to verify. A cvc_only card's payment window routes all of the browser's egress through Kernel's VGS outbound proxy, exactly as widely as a full card's: while it is open the proxy reveals the card's aliases to any destination the browser sends them to, not only the security code. An expired card requires a new purchase with a freshly collected CVC alias. The amount and merchant are recorded but do not restrict payment requests sent by the browser. Card updates are not supported; delete and create a new item instead.

amount.description: Integer amount in minor currency units (at most 1000000).

card.description: Required when creating the card. Never returned.

card_mode.description: Which card this purchase supplies, and the only part of it a read returns. full is a whole card from the customer's vault. cvc_only is a card the merchant already holds on file, whose checkout page asks for nothing but the security code. It must match spec.card: a full card that is missing pan_alias is rejected rather than treated as cvc_only. Omit it for full, which a read also omits.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code. Supported: aud, brl, cad, chf, czk, dkk, eur, gbp, hkd, inr, jpy, krw, mxn, nok, nzd, pln, sek, sgd, usd, zar.

merchant_url.description: Merchant checkout URL. Fill is allowed only on this URL's origin.

wallet.description: Key of the VGS wallet item whose configuration reads the aliases.

status.description: A VGS wallet is connected on creation. pending_authorization or degraded means its creation did not finish; reading the wallet retries it, and a wallet that stays degraded can be deleted and created again. Whether its configuration's credentials still work is checked when a card is authorized.

VgsWalletVaultItemSpec.description: Cards kept in the customer's own VGS vault. The wallet binds a VGS provider configuration and is connected on creation; it holds no cards and has no payment methods. Each purchase is a card item that carries the card's aliases from the customer's vault. The configuration binding cannot be changed after creation.

provider_config.description: Select a VGS configuration. Required, because there are no Kernel-managed VGS credentials for this provider.

description.description: Server-generated provider and lifecycle guidance for agents.

key.description: Immutable item key assigned when the item is created.

output.description: Untrusted page-provided output. Callers must treat it as potentially malicious input.

status.description: awaiting_submission means a non-autosubmit declarative form was populated but not submitted. Inspect the form, obtain any required confirmation, then submit through Playwright or computer interaction without invoking the tool again. The other statuses are terminal results.

WebMCPInvokeVaultItemOperationRequest.description: Invoke a WebMCP tool using values from a vaulted item. The browser must be attached to the item's vault. Discover the tool_ref, inputSchema, and source with GET /browsers/{id_or_name}/webmcp/tools or webmcp.listTools() in the Browser REPL (POST /browsers/{id_or_name}/repl) before invoking it. Input paths replace existing null slots in input. Tool output is returned without redaction and may include the supplied values. The tool may submit or perform other side effects. Any item destination restrictions apply to the tool's top-level page and registering frame (if any).

browser_id.description: Browser session ID, not a reusable browser name.

input.description: Public tool arguments with an existing null slot at each binding path. At most 64 KiB after JSON serialization, including substituted values. Never include vault values here.

page_url.description: Exact top-level URL from the discovered tool source (fragment omitted). This pins the target page; it does not authorize a destination.

timeout_sec.description: Tool invocation timeout in seconds; preflight and response handling have an additional bounded allowance. An indeterminate outcome is not retried.

tool_ref.description: Opaque reference to the exact live WebMCP registration.

WebMCPInvokeVaultItemOperationResult.description: Returns the same tool result fields as the browser WebMCP invoke API, plus the vault operation discriminator. Output and error text are untrusted page-provided data, returned without redaction; tools may include supplied vault values. Inspect the browser page to determine whether the intended site action succeeded.

error_text.description: Untrusted page-provided error text, returned without redaction. May contain supplied vault values.

invocation_id.description: Present when the browser reported one.

output.description: Untrusted page-provided output, returned without redaction. May contain supplied vault values.

status.description: Unknown means invocation may have run; do not retry automatically. No status confirms that the website accepted the action.

tool_ref.description: Opaque reference for invoking this exact live registration. It becomes invalid when its document or browser process is replaced.

WebMCPToolAnnotations.description: Tool-provided behavioral hints from the [MCP tool specification](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2025-11-25/server/tools#tool) and the [WebMCP ToolAnnotations definition](https://webmachinelearning.github.io/webmcp/#dictdef-toolannotations). These hints are untrusted and are not enforced by Kernel.

frame_id.description: Monotonically increasing identifier for this embedded frame during the current browser process.

url.description: Current frame URL with the fragment omitted.

WebMCPToolMetadata.description: Tool metadata follows the [MCP Tool definition](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2025-11-25/server/tools#tool) and the [WebMCP RegisteredTool definition](https://webmachinelearning.github.io/webmcp/#dictdef-registeredtool). outputSchema is optional for page and custom tools.

frame.description: Embedded frame that registered the tool, or null when the top-level page registered it.

page_title.description: Current title of the top-level page.

page_url.description: Current URL of the top-level page with the fragment omitted.

tab_id.description: Monotonically increasing identifier for the tab during the current browser process.

target_id.description: CDP target ID for a custom tool's registration tab; omitted for page-provided tools.

window_id.description: Monotonically increasing identifier for the browser window during the current browser process.

policy.description: Allow statements for resources in this rule's project, in the same format as a scoped API key policy. API key actions are not allowed.

project_id.description: The one project credentials from this rule are limited to.

security_version.description: Authority revision. Cosmetic updates do not widen permissions.

issuer_url.description: Exact expected signed issuer. Optional for github_actions and google_cloud, which each have one fixed issuer.

security_version.description: Authority revision. Cosmetic updates do not widen permissions.

ca_cert_pem.description: Optional public CA certificates. When set, only these CAs are trusted for key retrieval, in place of the system roots. Private keys and private-network retrieval are not supported.

claims.description: Exact string conditions keyed by RFC 6901 JSON Pointers. All conditions are ANDed.

repository.description: Friendly display name. Immutable IDs define the repository identity.

type.description: Must be the issuer's preset_type.

WorkloadIdentityPresetType.description: The kind of identity provider. GitHub Actions, Google Cloud and Microsoft Entra issuers are recognized by their issuer URL and must use their own type. Defaults to the type the issuer URL belongs to, or custom_oidc.

max_lifetime_seconds.description: Maximum incoming signed exp minus iat, independent of outgoing token lifetime. At most 172800 (48 hours), which covers Azure managed identity tokens that live slightly over 24 hours.

replay_protection.description: Whether an incoming token can be exchanged more than once before it expires. Defaults to single_use for github_actions, aws, microsoft_entra and custom_oidc, and to allow_reuse for kubernetes, because a pod reads the same projected token until it is rotated. google_cloud is always allow_reuse because Google identity tokens carry no token ID. allow_reuse can be set on microsoft_entra and custom_oidc, and single_use on kubernetes. github_actions and aws are always single_use.
